name: 2022-23 Makeup - MIE 1071-B  Basic Mechanical Engineering
subject: Basic Mechanical Engineering

questions.markdown:
An NGO is contemplating on a plan to setup a coal-fired boiler to generate steam for its mega kitchen to cater the mid-day meals to students in rural Government schools. It is required to generate 1500 kg of steam on an hourly basis at a pressure of 1250 kPa and temperature of 200°C. The treated water from the water treatment plant is fed into the boiler at a temperature of 24°C. Coal with a calorific value of 24 MJ/kg is available and its consumption is 120 grams per second. In order to bring down the operating expenses and improve the boiler efficiency, it is planned to install the following boiler accessories:

i) Economizer to increase the water temperature to 50°C which will eventually lead to a fuel saving of 15%.
ii) Air preheater to improve the combustion of coal thereby leading to reduction in coal consumption by 18%.

Suggest suitable action for the NGO supported by computations with regard to the boiler efficiency.

1000 kg of steam which is 14.25% wet is produced in a boiler at a pressure of 1.6 N/mm$^2$. Steam enters the super heater where its temperature is raised such that the degree of superheat is 180°C. From the super heater, steam is led to a heat exchanger for process heating where it loses 66.6% of its enthalpy. If the temperature of feed water is 30°C, determine:

i) Total heat added to feed water in the boiler.
ii) Total heat supplied in the super heater.
iii) Condition and related parameter of the steam at the exit point of heat exchanger.

Give Reasons for the following:

i) Fusible plug is placed at a location above the furnace of the Babcock and Wilcox boiler.
ii) Water tube boilers are used in thermal power plants.
iii) Steam separator is installed close to the steam turbine.

A vulcanizing machine needs to be powered using a motor and belt drive with direction of motion of machine's spindle reversed and to run with a reduction ratio of 3. The larger pulley has a diameter of 15 cm while the motor runs at 1440 rpm. The spindles of motor and the machine are 1000 mm apart. The coefficient of friction is 0.29 while the initial tension to be maintained while the system is stationary is 900 N. Determine the belt specification if the maximum tension in the belt is to be limited to 50 N/mm belt width.

Six gear wheels are available from A to F with number of teeth as 20, 40, 60, 80, 100 and 120 respectively. Build a simple gear train for the least speed possible. If a compound gear train is built using the above gear wheels, what is the percentage change in the output speed? The driving shaft rotates at 2880 rpm.
It is observed that a belt drive transmitting power to a machine tool is not able to achieve the estimated velocity ratio. Identify the possible causes and explain the same.

A twin cylinder diesel engine not having a cam shaft has a total swept volume of 6 liters and generates power at the rate of 25 cycles per second. The net brake load is 70 kg and the mean circumference of the brake drum is 4 m. Determine the power generated by the engine by ignoring the friction and by considering the friction if the mean effective pressure is 0.5 MPa and the calorific value of diesel is 43,900 kJ/kg.
Explain the working of an engine fitted with an air filter, admits the charge in an indirect manner and operating on constant volume heat addition and heat rejection processes.

Explain the significance of the following:

i) Scavenging stage in working of a 2-stroke engine.
ii) Choke in a carburettor.
iii) Flywheel in IC Engines.
With neat sketch, explain the lathe operation which is used to generate a steep tapered surface over a short length.

An already drilled hole needs to be enlarged for its entire length. This hole should to be further enlarged for a short initial length. With neat sketch, explain the major machining operations that are required to be carried out to achieve this.
Write short notes on additive manufacturing.
Explain briefly any four defects found in cast product.

Two rods of dissimilar material are to be joined in which the two materials must not be melted either in part or full. The joint must be able to withstand higher external force during its application and hence needs a strong joint. Suggest a suitable metal joining process and explain the same with neat labelled sketch.
Explain the limitations associated with punched tape and tape readers of NC machine.
